description: This file contains Redux action creators and related types for managing dashboard filters in the Superset frontend, including functions to change filters, update filter paths, layout components, and filter scopes.

methods.name: isValidFilter
methods.description: Utility function to verify if a given chartId is a valid filter in the current dashboard state.

methods.name: changeFilter
methods.description: Dispatches an action to change the filter values for a specific chart if valid.

methods.name: updateDirectPathToFilter
methods.description: Dispatches an action to update the direct path to a specific filter if valid.

methods.name: updateLayoutComponents
methods.description: Dispatches an action to update the dashboard layout components.

methods.name: updateDashboardFiltersScope
methods.description: Dispatches an action to update the scope of dashboard filters.
